comments.author: deependujha
comments.body:
Hi @GaetanLepage, thank you for raising this and for your work maintaining the nixpkgs package.

We've confirmed that the `2.6.4` tag was indeed force-pushed. This was possibly due to a mistake where the original release PR (#21701) was incorrectly targeted at `release/2.6.x` instead of `release/stable`. PR #21727 corrected this, which resulted in the tag being updated to point to the right commit.

Also worth noting, we've just released `2.6.5` (tag `2.6.5`, commit `be98784`), which is a clean tag with no such issues. You may want to update your nixpkgs package to this version.

https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/releases/tag/2.6.5

As there's no further actionable item here, I'll go ahead and close this issue. Thanks again for flagging it!

comments.author: GaetanLepage
comments.body: Thanks for the reply! FYI, you can toggle "Immutable releases" in your repository settings, which will prevent this mishap from happening again: Thanks also for mentioning 2.6.5, I've opened a PR to update our package: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/525131 Cheers!
